bounds.domain: Three one-shot process attempts and one initially dead owner. Four unique owner tokens, owner publication/failure, delayed stale observations, ordinary/quarantined ownership, release races and process death.
bounds.assumptions: Same-host process liveness is reliable and token collisions do not occur. Atomic filesystem rename, exclusive file creation and private real directories. Each process tries once in this model; the implementation repeats rejected admission until its finite timeout. Ownerless stale-age expiration is abstracted as an enabled stale observation. Arbitrary malicious same-UID directory mutation and kernel/power-loss fsync behavior are outside the model.
bounds.progress: Weak fairness of each live process step and dead/unpublished quarantine cleanup. A crashed process ceases its effects. Persistent I/O failure can leave fail-closed ownership and does not promise successful acquisition.

assumptions: Checked formula in AccountStorageLock: AttemptsTerminate = FairWork.implies(eventually( processes.forall(p => s.pc.get(p).in(Set("done", "dead")))))

Model fairness predicate FairWork = processes.forall(p => and { claim(p).weakFair(s), publication(p).weakFair(s), inspectAdmission(p).weakFair(s), enter(p).weakFair(s), leave(p).weakFair(s), findRelease(p).weakFair(s), stageRelease(p).weakFair(s), finishRelease(p).weakFair(s), }) and tokens.forall(token => cleanQuarantine(token).weakFair(s))
The property is conditional on its written model fairness and environmental premises. Real scheduler fairness, provider completion and implementation refinement are not proved.
